gaps.text:
CORE GAPS — drawn here, not in core yet (mirror of docs/web/CORE-GAPS.md · audited 2026-10-11 against main@b2b4473, re-audited 2026-10-12 at main@7743665, re-checked at main@6b4e5dc)
✓ = landed on main. Default deployment runs access "legacy": operator data is protected mode only.

Owner to decide first
• Activity categories: core envelope spec has 5, the design has 8 (+ entity key, position)
• Device names / last seen (access spec excludes them) · labels for TG, capcode, MMSI

Spectrum
✓ FFT stream (spectrum WS, 0.5–25 Hz, 128–2048 bins)
• Real zoom (viewed-slice spec, not built) · FFT size to 16384 + averaging per client
• Waterfall backfill on subscribe · WS tuner control for drag-to-pan

Band plans and presets (one package · drawn 2026-10-12, v83)
• Configurable band plans, layered: country packs (EU baseline + France first) · imports (SDR++ JSON, SDR# XML, Gqrx CSV) with provenance · your edits
• Labels per country (FR: PMR = PMR446, not 136–174) · groups, channels + aliases, mode/bw/step, scan hints, skip by default
  partly: scanner plans EU/US only · regional registry mounted read-only (US FRS only, no data yet) = the verified layer
• Station country (ISO) from the station location, override, WAVEKIT_COUNTRY · picks the default pack
• Ordered plan stack + on/off synced · edit layer with per-field reset · import by file or URL: preview, group mapping, manual check for update with diff
• Plan skips + channels covered by decoders feed scan exclusions · protocols and spacing per range
• Airband, 466 e*Message, Wize 169.4 ≠ pagers, PMR446 446.0–446.2, CB 27, 380–400 skip · scan presets in core (built-in + yours)

Tuner
• Capabilities endpoint (gains in dB, rate presets, range, offset/bias-T) · DC / IQ correction
  partly: receiver-capabilities mounted read-only (controls, tunerType, gainCount; no gain table)

Audio
• One WS audio stream, 48 kHz, latency · live-audio:level at 10–20 Hz
• Squelch modes (auto / noise) without restart · AGC, NR, NB, notch, BFO, DSB

Analog transmissions (one package)
• Squelch events · analog vs digital per transmission · CTCSS / DCS · DTMF · recording id

Activity and events
• Decode envelope live + stored · event store with typed filters + full text · facets
• DMR / P25 call metadata · rate history per decoder · auto band map

Event contract
• Seq + replay from a cursor (activity + scanner) · scanner progress at 2 Hz

Access
✓ Public bootstrap · ✓ devices list
• Browser onboarding, TLS acceptance, non-legacy default · read-only role

Scanner (S1 on main)
• Auto-resume that never cuts a call: hold while squelch open / identify runs, resumeAt, "Stay here" = pause
• Identity search · ScannerProtocol ais / acars / vdl2 / lora
• Per range: name, dwell, sensitivity, exclusions (+ provenance) · signals-only flag
• Ranges on/off + per-range protocols mid-scan (PATCH ranges[i]) · Ignore also skips sweeps · decodedElsewhere in plan
• Per-job hit stats + new flag · Watch here protocols · preemptedBy · saved freq ↔ discovery
• Follow hits: demodulator follows a hit inside the hop, no retune · per-band default · hits named from the plan · plan reports one-hop watches
• S2 enabled, S3 Scan a list
• Per-range protocols tried per hop (today one job-wide union; overlap dedupe ✓)
✓ Decoder IDs in impact

Recordings (with the event store)
• Auto-record all + retention · recording state on events · Keep · manual record + trim
• IQ capture + playback as source · peaks / thumbnails · storage endpoint · download/transcode

Map
• AIS / APRS / mesh state · mesh links · position history · coverage · PMTiles · ACARS/AIS positions

Settings and station
• Station identity in core · settings store + one schema · decoder options at runtime
• Operator settings synced (columns, pinned searches, attached pane open, frecency) · decoder log tail · sdr-host version · export/import
